name: Azumi Mayuri
source:
An onee-san who lives near protagonist's house.
Protagonist usually saw her on the way to school and on weekends.

She seems to be a university student as she wears a similar uniform.  
Protagonist idolized her.

"Someone seems to follow me recently."
